import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import harness

fixtures = json.loads(open('/workspace/examples/checks.json').read())
policy = '--policy' in sys.argv
fails = 0
for i, fx in enumerate(fixtures):
    data = fx.get('raw')
    if data is None:
        data = json.dumps(fx['request'], separators=(',', ':'))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = harness.run_bytes(data.encode(), policy=policy)
    dt = time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('FAIL', i, 'exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[:500]); fails += 1; continue
    try:
        got = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception as exc:
        print('FAIL', i, 'json', exc, p.stdout[:200]); fails += 1; continue
    if got != fx['response']:
        print('FAIL', i, 'mismatch')
        print('  got ', json.dumps(got)[:500])
        print('  want', json.dumps(fx['response'])[:500])
        fails += 1
    else:
        print('ok fixture %d (%.2fs, stderr=%d bytes)' % (i, dt, len(p.stderr)))
print('policy=%s failures=%d' % (policy, fails))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/dev && python3 publocal.py 2>&1 | tail -15
